# Shri Krishna Dental Hospital

> Multi-specialty Dental Hospital & Centre for Advanced Dental Implants, Clear Aligners, Laser Dentistry, and Painless Root Canal Therapy in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

Empanelled with **EHS (Employees' Health Scheme) under Aarogyasree** for Telangana State Government employees, pensioners, and eligible healthcare beneficiaries. Formerly known and operating as **Jo'Dent Dental Clinic**.

## Organization & Local Entities
- **Official Name**: Shri Krishna Dental Hospital
- **Alternate Name / History**: Jo'Dent Dental Clinic
- **Main Address**: Ground Floor, Allwyn X Roads, near Bank of India, Allwyn X Road, Widia Colony, Hafeezpet, Miyapur, Hyderabad, Telangana 500049, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: [+91 95154 25522](tel:+919515425522)
- **Website**: https://shrikrishnadental.com/
- **Geo Coordinates**: Latitude `17.4933`, Longitude `78.3411`
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM | Sunday: By Prior Appointment
- **Google Rating**: 4.9/5 (Based on 480+ verified patient reviews)
- **Primary Service Areas**: Miyapur, Chandanagar, Hafeezpet, Kondapur, Allwyn X Road, Madinaguda, Kukatpally, Gachibowli, Hitec City, Hyderabad

## Clinical Leadership & Specialists
- **Dr. S. K. Krishna**: BDS, MDS (Prosthodontics & Oral Implantology) – Chief Dental Surgeon & Senior Implantologist with 15+ years experience. Specializes in single/multiple dental implants, All-on-4/All-on-6 full-mouth restorations, and digital smile makeovers.
- **Dr. Radhika Sharma**: BDS, MDS (Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopedics) – Senior Orthodontist & Certified Clear Aligner Specialist (Invisalign & Spark). Specializes in invisible braces, bite alignment, and pediatric interceptive orthodontics.
- **Specialist Team**: Full-time in-house MDS Endodontists (Microscopic Single-Sitting RCT), Pediatric Dentists (Pedodontists), Periodontists (Laser Gum Care), and Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeons (Painless Wisdom Tooth Removal).

## Core Dental Treatments & Specialties
- [Dental Implants](https://shrikrishnadental.com/dental-implants.html): Titanium & Zirconia implants (Nobel Biocare, Straumann, Osstem), immediate loading implants, bone grafting, sinus lifts, and All-on-4/6 full arch rehabilitation.
- [Clear Aligners & Invisible Braces](https://shrikrishnadental.com/aligners.html): 3D digital intraoral scan smile design, Invisalign, Spark aligners, self-ligating braces, ceramic aesthetic braces.
- [Painless Root Canal Treatment (RCT)](https://shrikrishnadental.com/root-canal-treatment.html): Single-sitting rotary endodontics, apex locator precision, rubber dam isolation, zirconia/porcelain crown capping.
- [Laser Dentistry](https://shrikrishnadental.com/laser-dentistry.html): Minimally invasive soft-tissue diode laser treatments, laser gum depigmentation, bloodless frenectomy, photobiomodulation.
- [Wisdom Tooth Removal & Oral Surgery](https://shrikrishnadental.com/dental-clinic-services.html): Atraumatic surgical extractions, impacted wisdom tooth removal, bone preservation.
- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://shrikrishnadental.com/pediatric-dentistry.html): Pain-free child dental care, pit & fissure sealants, fluoride varnish, pulpectomy, and habit-breaking appliances.
- [Cosmetic Dentistry & Smile Makeover](https://shrikrishnadental.com/cosmetic-dentistry.html): Zoom! teeth whitening, custom porcelain veneers, composite bonding, gum contouring.
